title: Move to multi-board kanbus-api (Kanbus#502) and the kanbus:cyclotron/prospectus group
description:
Kanbus#502 (kbs-9cb5cb40, merged to Kanbus develop 2026-10-20) makes kanbus-api serve many boards. Routes gain a board prefix (/{tenant}/{project}/api/...), and KANBUS_NAMESPACE and KANBUS_REQUIRED_GROUP are removed in favour of Cognito groups named kanbus:<tenant>/<project>. Prospectus is unaffected until it bumps its pinned Kanbus commit (source-lock.json). Follow the 'Migration for single-board deployments' section of services/kanbus-api/README.md.

Steps:
1. (Ryan's approval required: production user pool change.) Create the Cognito group kanbus:cyclotron/prospectus in the prospectus-members user pool and copy every member of the prospectus-members group into it. Both groups coexist, so nothing breaks.
2. In ONE deploy: bump the pinned Kanbus commit; drop KANBUS_NAMESPACE and KANBUS_REQUIRED_GROUP from the kanbus-api Lambda (infra/lib/prospectus-backend.ts); move the gateway route /api/{proxy+} to /cyclotron/prospectus/api/{proxy+} (the /api/saas routes stay); set the CRM client base (src/client.ts) to the prefixed path; in server/canonical-invoke.ts send rawPath /cyclotron/prospectus/api/... and cognito:groups kanbus:cyclotron/prospectus; replace KANBUS_NAMESPACE with KANBUS_TENANT=cyclotron and KANBUS_PROJECT=prospectus in local preview, CI (infra/scripts/test-browser-ci.sh) and the integration tests; and update the infra tests that assert the old env vars and group.
3. Verify: CRM sign-in and board load, a contact intake submission landing as a prospect, Accounts BFF routes unaffected, and canonical S3 keys unchanged.
4. (Ryan's approval required.) Remove the old prospectus-members group once nothing depends on it.

Notes: the query budgets (1,000 catalog candidates, 422 query_budget_exceeded, 2.5 MiB response cap) are not new; they have existed since the service's first commit. No @kanbus/ui component calls kanbus-api, so the client base is the only frontend change.
